Deliver version v2 / patch-1: requests/sessions.py Session.request now decodes a bytes method instead of rendering it with builtin_str.

Defect per issue: builtin_str in requests/compat.py is plain `str` on both the is_py2 and is_py3 branches. On Python 2 builtin_str is the bytes type, so b'GET' passed through unchanged — matching the reporter's note that 2.6 was unaffected and neutronclient's safe_encode_list (which returns bytes) broke only on 3.4.

Fix (only requests/sessions.py, only Session.request):
  if isinstance(method, bytes):
      method = method.decode('utf8')
  elif method is not None:
      method = str(method)
